evals.name: Single Document - Industrial Pump Manual
evals.description: Single attached file; language and format already stated in the prompt. Tests the basic single-file path and the skip rule.
evals.prompt: Ho appena ricevuto il manuale di installazione di una pompa centrifuga industriale. Puoi farmi un riassunto tecnico in italiano in Word? Lo allego adesso.
assertions: No preference question is asked (language and format already stated); generation starts once the document is read
Report is a .docx file written in Italian
Report contains exactly three top-level sections (introduction, topics, final synthesis), with headings written in Italian
The topics section covers installation steps, technical specifications, safety warnings, and maintenance
Numerical specifications (e.g., 120 m³/h, 7,5 kW, IP55) match the source exactly
File is named following the summary_*_IT.docx convention
On Claude Code the absolute file path is reported; on claude.ai the platform file delivery is used

evals.name: URL Source - Example Page
evals.description: Single URL input with language and format already specified. Tests the URL success path and the full skip rule.
evals.prompt: Can you summarize the technical content at this URL for me? https://example.com — I need it in English as a PDF.
assertions: URL content is fetched and analyzed before anything else
No preference question is asked (language and format already stated)
The report reflects the actual content of the fetched page (the placeholder page is thin, so depth expectations stay modest)
Summary is a structured PDF in English named summary_*_EN.pdf

evals.name: Multi-file Aggregation - Installation Manuals
evals.description: Three attached technical files merged into one report. Tests corpus aggregation.
evals.prompt: Allego tre documenti tecnici (manuali di installazione di tre apparecchiature industriali, tre copie dello stesso esempio). Voglio un unico report che li sintetizzi tutti e tre, in italiano, formato Markdown.
assertions: All three files are aggregated into one corpus before analysis
A single Markdown file in Italian is produced
The report covers the topics of all three documents, not one report per file
Every topic the Phase 3 analysis identified reaches Discussed Topics, on its own or grouped under a broader heading, and no source document is left unrepresented

evals.name: Partial Retrieval - One URL Fails
evals.description: Two URLs, one accessible and one returning 404. Tests per-URL notification and aggregation of the successfully retrieved content.
evals.prompt: Summarize these two pages for me: https://example.com and https://example.com/pump-series-b. I want a technical summary in English as a Word document.
assertions: Both URLs are attempted before anything else
The user is told which URL failed (https://example.com/pump-series-b) and why
The run proceeds with the successfully retrieved content instead of stopping
A single .docx summary in English follows the mandatory three-section structure and reflects the retrieved page

evals.name: Language Override - Scientific Article
evals.description: Attached scientific article (sample-article.md) summarized in French as PDF. Tests non-default, non-Italian output.
evals.prompt: Ti allego un articolo scientifico sulla corrosione dell'acciaio inossidabile in ambienti salini. Riassumilo in francese come PDF.
assertions: No preference question is asked (language and format already stated)
A structured PDF report in French is produced
Report covers the experimental methodology, the comparative results, the material properties, and the conclusions
Acronyms are expanded in French (SCC, LPR, PREN)
Numerical results (e.g., 11,2 µm/anno, 0,32 mm, 2 000 ore) match the source exactly
File is named following the summary_*_FR.pdf convention

evals.name: No source attached
evals.description: Prompt with no attachment, pasted text, or URL. Tests the Phase 1 guard.
evals.prompt: Ciao, puoi farmi un riassunto tecnico del manuale? Te lo mando tra poco.
assertions: The FIRST message asks the user to attach, paste, or link the source document(s)
The request is written in Italian, the language of the user's request
No preference question (language, format) is asked and no report is generated before the source arrives

evals.name: Preference question - nothing stated
evals.description: Single attached file, neither language nor format stated. Tests the single combined question and its language.
assertions: Exactly ONE message asks for both language and format together, before any report content
The question is written in Italian, the language of the user's request
Italian is offered as the default; an 'Other' option is available for both questions
No report is generated before the user answers

evals.name: Partial Preferences - Format stated, Language not
evals.description: Attached file with the output format stated but the language unstated. Tests the omit-answered-questions rule: only the missing preference is asked.
evals.prompt: Riassumimi questo manuale tecnico in Markdown.
assertions: Exactly ONE question is asked, requesting only the output language; the format is not asked again
The question is written in Italian, the language of the user's request
Italian is offered as the default
No report is generated before the user answers

evals.name: Partial Preferences - Language stated, Format not
evals.description: Attached file with the output language stated but the format unstated. Tests the omit-answered-questions rule on the other axis, and the Word default when the user names no format.
evals.prompt: Riassumimi questo manuale tecnico in italiano.
assertions: Exactly ONE question is asked, requesting only the output format; the language is not asked again
The question is written in Italian, the language of the user's request
If the user replies without choosing a format, the skill defaults to Word (.docx) without asking again
No report is generated before the user answers

evals.name: Total Retrieval Failure - Both URLs Dead
evals.description: Two URLs, both returning 404. Tests the full Phase 1 stop guard: per-URL notification, no report, no preference question.
evals.prompt: Summarize these two pages for me: https://example.com/manual-a and https://example.com/manual-b. I want a technical summary in English as a Word document.
assertions: Both URLs are attempted before anything else
The user is told that both URLs failed (https://example.com/manual-a and https://example.com/manual-b) and why
No report is generated: the empty corpus is not summarized
No preference question (language, format) is asked; the skill stops and asks the user how to proceed
The stop message is written in English, the language of the user's request

evals.name: Right-to-left output language
evals.description: The user asks for the summary in Arabic as a PDF. Tests the right-to-left branch of Phase 8, which contains a refusal: the fpdf2 fallback is switched off, so an unavailable weasyprint must stop and ask rather than ship unshaped text. Also grades the Phase 4 to Phase 6 terminology handoff, since the target language is only known from Phase 5 onwards.
evals.prompt: Summarize the attached document in Arabic as a PDF.
assertions: No preference question is asked: language and format were both stated in the request
On an environment without document skills, the PDF is built with weasyprint and the fpdf2 fallback is NOT used, because fpdf2 does not shape right-to-left text
If weasyprint is unavailable, the skill asks the user to install it or offers Markdown instead, rather than producing a PDF with unshaped text
The rendered PDF lays the text out right-to-left, not left-to-right
The three mandatory sections are present, with their titles written in Arabic
Acronym expansions are written in Arabic, while the acronyms themselves and the internationally recognized terms (ISO codes, part numbers, model codes) keep their original form
The filename carries the uppercase language code: summary_[abbreviated_source_name]_AR.pdf
Page size is A4
Numeric runs inside the Arabic text — specification values, tolerances, part numbers, standard references, dates — read left-to-right, so no sign or unit detaches from its value

eval_notes: All sample material is fictional: evals/sample-document.md is an invented Italian installation/maintenance manual for an industrial centrifugal pump (model CP-200), and evals/sample-article.md is an invented Italian scientific article on stainless-steel corrosion in saline environments (case 5); case 3 attaches the manual three times to exercise the aggregation path. URLs use the reserved example.com domain, so a runner can never fetch a real third-party site: the root https://example.com serves a real, stable placeholder page, while every subpath returns 404. Cases cover: skip rule (1, 2, 5), URL success path (2), partial retrieval with per-URL notification (4), multi-source aggregation (3), language override (5), missing source (6), the combined preference question in the user's language (7), and partial preferences with one preference missing (8: format stated, 9: language stated, including the Word default when the user names no format), and total retrieval failure with the stop guard (10). Every case that produces a report expects the mandatory three-section structure from references/report-structure.md and the summary_*_[LANG].[ext] filename convention from SKILL.md. Case 11 covers a branch no other case reaches: a right-to-left output language, where the fpdf2 fallback is off and an unavailable weasyprint must stop and ask instead of shipping unshaped text; it also grades the Phase 4 to Phase 6 terminology handoff, since the target language is only known from Phase 5 onwards, and the left-to-right order of the numbers inside that text. Case 3 also grades the Phase 7 topic-coverage check: every topic Phase 3 identified reaches the report. Eleven cases in total.
